description: Krutrim (Krutrim SI Designs Private Limited, part of India's Ola group) runs Krutrim Cloud, an Indian AI cloud whose AI Studio hosts open-source and in-house models. Its in-house Bhashik model provides Indic speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech translation APIs for English and eight Indian languages, billed in INR per audio minute/hour.
name: Krutrim
